C0679.title: Guangdong Tech Co. Webpage Defacement Case
C0679.summary: During routine work, the cyberspace administration discovered that the login page of an office collaboration platform belonging to a Guangdong technology company had been defaced with illegal content. Investigation revealed an arbitrary file upload vulnerability in the system.
